act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law for the limitation of suits and other proceedings and for purposes connected therewith.

section.heading: Computation of time mentioned in instruments
section.html: All instruments shall for the purposes of this Act be deemed to be made with reference to the Gregorian calendar.
section.text: All instruments shall for the purposes of this Act be deemed to be made with reference to the Gregorian calendar.
